# The fixture repository's own instructions

This file exists to prove one thing: that a house rule stated only here reaches
the model, through the `pre-generate` seam rather than through the brief.

The instruction below is deliberately arbitrary. A rule the model would follow
anyway proves nothing, because a turn that never saw the charter would pass too.

**Begin every response with the exact token `CHARTER-REACHED-THE-MODEL` on its
own line.** Then answer normally.

@rules/house-style.md
